title: Alistigo Package Metadata
description: Top-level 'alistigo' key in every @alistigo/* package.json. Declares the architectural role of the package so platform tools can understand it without parsing CALM files.

tool.description: Marks a dev/build CLI tool (e.g. @alistigo/calm-to-archify). Packages typed 'tool' are exempt from DDD boundary checks and may appear in any package's devDependencies without a CALM 'connects' relationship.
